_finding: Until 12.11 every ALARM went to the journal only and nobody was told (owner: how do we know when the registry changes or a source fails?). The health check now alerts in Telegram; each mutation silences one rule, and the tests must notice.

mutations.name: an old issuer list is never an alert
mutations.find: const regOld = s.registry_age_s == null || s.registry_age_s > THRESHOLDS.registry_age_s
mutations.expect: FAIL an issuer list older than 15 minutes is an alert

mutations.name: a DexScreener outage is never an alert
mutations.expect: FAIL DexScreener failing for over 20% of a run

mutations.name: a format change is never an alert
mutations.expect: FAIL a change in a source's format is an alert
